#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const int INF = 99999999;

int main() {
    int x, y, n;
    cin >> x >> y >> n;

    double min_diff = INF;
    int numerator, denominator;

    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        int tx = static_cast<int>(round(1.0 * x * i / y - 0.0000001));
        double current_diff = fabs((1.0 * x / y) - (1.0 * tx / i));
        if (current_diff < min_diff) {
            numerator = tx;
            denominator = i;
            min_diff = current_diff;
        }
    }

    cout << numerator << "/" << denominator;
    return 0;
}
